hints: ColabFold names models `..._rank_001_...` (best) to `..._rank_005_...`. `ls {{res.0}}_af/*rank_001*` finds the best one.
`cp {{res.0}}_af/*unrelaxed_rank_001*.pdb best.pdb`. Use cp, not mv, so the results folder stays complete.
